issue_context.title: [Bug]: route.fetch fails to decompress 'br' encoding: unexpected end of file
issue_context.body:
### Version

1.45.3

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a file with the following code
```js
import {chromium} from "playwright";

const targetURL = 'https://booking.com'; // A website using Brotli


const browser = await chromium.launch({headless: false});

const workingPage = await browser.newPage();
await workingPage.goto(targetURL, {timeout: 60_000});
await workingPage.close();
console.log('Working page loaded successfully and closed');

const context = await browser.newContext();


await context.route('**/*', async (route, request) => {
    const response = await route.fetch();
    if (response) {
        await route.fulfill({ response });
    } else {
        await route.fallback(); // let playwright do the request as intended
    }
});

const page = await context.newPage();
await page.goto(targetURL, {timeout: 60_000});
```

2. run the file

### Expected behavior

The node process should execute without crashing.
